verdict.rationale: The API reference introduction documents an interactive playground for testing calls, and per-endpoint reference pages exist (e.g., list corporate cards), so the core of an interactive reference with runnable calls is delivered. The evidence is a single thin first-party mention with no detail on how the playground works. missing for 10: detail on runnable code samples per endpoint (languages, auth handling, sandbox environment), independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404)
